crs.defined.description: Each georeferenced input declares a CRS.

crs.consistent.description: Inputs that are combined share one CRS; a mismatch fails until they are reprojected.

crs.metric_operation.description: A distance, area, or buffer operation runs in a projected horizontal CRS with metre or foot units, not in degrees or geocentric coordinates.

geometry.valid.description: Every geometry is valid (no self-intersections or invalid rings).

geometry.non_empty.description: No null or empty geometries are present.

geometry.type_consistent.description: The layer holds one geometry family; single and multi-part types count together.

scope.record_count.description: The output feature count is compared with a reference dataset's count.

raster.nodata_declared.description: Every raster band declares a nodata value.

raster.resampling.description: The resampling method suits categorical data (nearest or mode).

raster.grid_alignment.description: Rasters share CRS, pixel size, and pixel-grid origin so they can be combined.

raster.cog_layout.description: Heuristic layout screen for GeoTIFFs: tiled, with internal overviews unless the raster fits in one block; not COG validation.

rs.reflectance_range.description: Sampled plausibility screen: reflectance values lie within [-0.5, 1.5]; non-finite scale, offset, or values fail. Not a calibration check.

rs.index_range.description: Sampled plausibility screen: spectral index values lie within [-1, 1]; non-finite scale, offset, or values fail.

stac.provenance.description: A STAC Item records a time and a projection code.
